defects.quote: they account for all 3688 errors in the window
defects.why: The checkout error count is a whole-run transaction aggregate and cannot be assigned to the shorter policy window from these aggregates.

defects.quote: Max latency values (10008 ms) are single extremes
defects.why: The aggregates do not show how many samples reached the maximum latency.

notes: The advice offers useful checks but overstates what the aggregates establish about window attribution and maximum latency.
